newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OPTIONS -- KPN AND ABN AMRO STAR ON BUSY EOE.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS -- KPN AND ABN AMRO STAR ON BUSY EOE.

text.p: An active European Options Exchange (EOE) saw heavy demand for calls in shares on the move on Wednesday as investors looked to buy into further rallies.

Dutch PTT (KPN) was active after the announced takeover bid for Australia's TNT. Nearly 11,000 calls were traded in KPN options against around 1,300 puts. But more active was ABN AMRO whose shares jumped on its plans to spin-off MeesPierson.
Over 27,000 calls were traded against 8,000 puts making it the most active on the EOE capturing 23 percent of total trade. AEX options were down in second place, taking under 20 percent.
